correctness.rationale: For independent Bernoulli(p) vectors X,Y and symmetric increasing threshold H_{n,k}, the exact disjoint witness criterion is S>=k,T>=k,U=|X∨Y|>=2k; hence product defect D=P(S>=k,T>=k,U<2k), and Δ=P(Bin(n,p)>=k)^2−P(Bin(n,p)>=2k). The sandwich P(U<2k)−2P(S<k)<=D<=P(U<2k), together with p<u=2p−p²<1, Chernoff and binomial CLTs, proves Gaussian windows at k=np/2+x√n and k=nu/2+x√n. Source Section 6 pivot identity with conditional X|occupied Bernoulli(1/(2−p)) gives exponentially negligible support failures and a local CLT √n π_i→φ(z)/σu and ||ρ||₂ same. Bivariate CLT for (J=sum XY,U) yields Gaussian truncation G_U<2x and conditional mean −p²(1−u)φ(z)/(σu Φ(z)); second moments give uniform integrability. Rare phase k/n→a∈(0,u/2) uses relative conditional Chernoff + binomial tail Stirling/geometric ratio with r_n=(2k−1)/n to retain lattice corrections. Independently enumerated all pairs of bit masks through n=6 at p=2/5, checking exact finite D, Δ and union-tail sandwich; asymptotics justified analytically, not finite samples.
